data.title: Magecart WebSocket Card Data Exfiltration — Payment Page to Recently Registered Domain
data.description: Detects Magecart-style card data exfiltration via WebSocket connections from e-commerce checkout or payment pages to recently registered domains (< 90 days) that masquerade as legitimate services (analytics, CDN, jQuery). The ANY.RUN "Banks Magecart Campaign" (March 2026) documented a 24+ month campaign across 100+ domains targeting the Redsys payment system (Spain), PayPlug SAS, and generic Visa/Mastercard flows. The attack uses a multi-stage injection model: (1) obfuscated loader injected into site scripts, (2) rotating domains deliver secondary payloads, (3) DOM monitoring conceals legitimate payment buttons and injects fake payment interfaces, (4) WebSocket connections (wss://<c2>/?token=<base64>) exfiltrate full card data (BIN, PAN, expiry, CVV). WebSocket is chosen specifically to reduce visibility in traditional HTTP-based security monitoring. Detection combines three signals: WebSocket connection from a payment/checkout page context, destination domain registered within 90 days, and domain name pattern masquerading as a legitimate service (analytics, CDN, jQuery, caching). The confirmed IOC domain list from the campaign uses registrar NICENIC INTERNATIONAL GROUP, identified by Silent Push as a bulletproof registrar.

detection.condition: selection_websocket AND filter_domain_age AND (filter_masquerade_pattern OR filter_base64_token) AND NOT filter_legitimate

enrichment_required.source: WHOIS domain registration date lookup; days since domain creation
WHOIS registrar name for bulletproof registrar correlation
TLS certificate issuer for free/automated CA detection (Let's Encrypt prevalence in campaign)

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL — Magecart WebSocket Card Data Exfiltration Detection")`
`comment("Detects WebSocket exfiltration from payment pages to recently registered masquerading domains")`
index=flame_web_security sourcetype=flame:web_security
  connection_type="websocket" request_url="wss://*"
| eval referer_page_type = if(match(referer_url, "(checkout|payment|billing|cart/complete|redsys|payplug)"), "payment_page", "other")
| where referer_page_type="payment_page"
| where NOT match(destination_domain, "(stripe\.com|paypal\.com|braintreegateway\.com|adyen\.com|authorize\.net|redsys\.es|payplug\.com|google-analytics\.com|hotjar\.com|jquery\.com|bootstrapcdn\.com)")
| eval masquerade_match = if(match(destination_domain, "(analytics|cache|cdn|jquery|bootstrap|bundle|assets|hotjar|doubleclick|captcha|secure|referrer|wishlist|feedback|explorer|redsys)"), 1, 0)
| eval token_match = if(match(request_url, "token="), 1, 0)
| where (masquerade_match=1 OR token_match=1) AND destination_domain_age_days <= 90
| eval ioc_match = if(destination_domain IN (
    "bundle-feedback.com", "doubleclickcache.com", "analyticsgctm.com",
    "hotjarcdn.com", "firefoxcaptcha.com", "solutionjquery.com",
    "jquerybootstrap.com", "assetsbundle.com", "bundle-referrer.com",
    "categorywishlist.com", "cachesecure.com", "securedata-ns.com",
    "analysiscache.com", "newassetspro.com", "explorerpros.com", "redsysgate.com"), 1, 0)
| eval risk_level = case(
    ioc_match=1, "critical",
    destination_domain_age_days <= 30 AND masquerade_match=1 AND token_match=1, "critical",
    destination_domain_age_days <= 30, "high",
    1=1, "high")
| stats count AS connection_count,
        values(referer_url) AS referer_urls,
        values(request_url) AS request_urls,
        values(destination_ip) AS dest_ips,
        values(destination_domain_age_days) AS domain_age,
        values(destination_domain_registrar) AS registrar,
        max(ioc_match) AS is_known_ioc,
        values(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        dc(session_id) AS unique_sessions
  BY destination_domain
| sort - connection_count

references: ANY.RUN, Banks Magecart Campaign: Multi-Stage Injection and WebSocket Exfiltration (March 2026)
Recorded Future, Annual Payment Fraud Intelligence Report 2025 — e-skimmer telemetry and blockchain C2
Silent Push — NICENIC INTERNATIONAL GROUP bulletproof registrar analysis
falsepositives: Legitimate third-party payment or analytics services using WebSocket connections from checkout pages that happen to have recently registered domains
Development or staging environments using test domains with WebSocket connections for payment flow testing
Newly deployed legitimate payment integration partners with recently registered service domains
